theorems.name: Submission.dtc_blowUp_massOn_image
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (W : Set (Euclid P)), (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').massOn (dilation x lam '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * T.massOn W
